entries.text: Four top-level skills run in one fixed order: vantrilex-prime orients the machine once, vantrilex-vanguard equips the project once per project, vantrilex-workflow-forge authors the standing methodology before execution, and vantrilex-doctrine governs how the work runs once the kit is installed.

Doctrine states the seven constitutional laws, assigns decision rights across the Leader, Guide, and Implementer roles, binds each lifecycle phase to its kit, and defines the five workflows with their gates and done-definitions.

The canonical standing-directive text is merged into the governed project's AGENTS.md and mirrored into the generated CLAUDE.md, then re-verified on every later run, so the permanent rules are stated once in the file the OpenCode V2 runtime auto-loads.

Execution never starts before the forge skill authors the standing methodology: the run invokes vantrilex-workflow-forge at each task start and seeds Part A of the target WORKFLOW.md from the canonical copy it carries; a start without that invocation fails its gate and the run stops before the first dispatch.

A task never closes without both landings the close gate requires: a dated revision note on Part A of the target WORKFLOW.md when the methodology changed, and the per-task AGENT.md update beside it; only the orchestrator writes AGENT.md, after every task, rotating closed entries into docs/agent-log-YYYY-MM.md.
